preamble: Devoicing of the voiced alveolo-palatal fricative [ʑ] to [ɕ]. In Lhasa Tibetan the voiced series of Written Tibetan devoiced and the lost voicing was transferred to a low tone, so written zh- and bzh- are read [ɕ] with low register, while Dzongkha keeps [ʑ]. In Polish, word-final devoicing turns ź [ʑ] into [ɕ], which alternates with [ʑ] before vowels.
